Show a paywall's live build at a location from now on. Deploying a newer build of the paywall
updates the location too.

Asks first when it replaces what end users see there; --yes skips that. With --env test only apps
using a test key see it, production keeps what it shows, and nothing is asked.

Usage:
  voidhash location show [location] [paywall] [flags]

Arguments:
  location  The location's slug, name or id
  paywall   The paywall's slug, name or id

Flags:
      --env <production|test>  Whose apps it changes: production (the default), or test, which only
                               apps using a test key see; test follows production until the location
                               is given a test showing of its own
  -h, --help                   Show help for this command
      --json                   Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --project <project>      Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default:
                               this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                  Print only ids, one per line
  -y, --yes                    Make the change without asking for confirmation

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash location show home pro
  voidhash location show home summer-sale --env test
